name: const unsafe fn offset_from (self , origin : NonNull < T >) -> isize where T : Sized ,
rule: For safety, `self` and `origin` must either point to the same address, or both be derived from a pointer to the same allocated object with the entire memory range between them in bounds of that object. This requirement applies both at runtime and during constant evaluation.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { const unsafe fn offset_from (self , origin : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T >) -> isize where T : Sized , }
